text:
laura: Draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1301. Added 'compact-schema' examples for tool calling and a tiny SDK snippet. Can reviewers check link targets, property names, and the migration blurb?
ci-bot: build passed :white_check_mark: preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1301
alex: Quick note: snippet uses `response.output_schema` but client exposes `response.schema`. Should align to avoid confusion.
laura: Good catch, will update to `response.schema`.
sameer: For nullable arrays, runtime expects explicit union on items. Example to use: {"type":"array","items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}]}}
maria: UX suggestion: include a 1-line streaming fallback in the SDK example, e.g. check `res.stream` and iterate `for await` so readers don't miss streaming behavior.
tim: Product nit: add one sentence about when to use compact-schema vs full JSON Schema (tradeoffs: tokens vs strictness). Helps migration decisions.
laura: Will add that and fix links (there was a stale /docs/function-calling link -> /docs/tool-calling). Also renamed example file to match links.
sameer: pushed a tiny schema tweak to the PR (using anyOf for object/null). No ML blockers.
laura: Thanks! Merging in ~10m unless anyone objects.
alex: :thumbsup:
